_about: Every network source the ingestion pipeline reads. Nothing here is scraped: each entry is a file the publisher distributes for download (a data archive, a published feed, or a documented export). `terms` records where the reuse terms were checked.

sources.note: Douay-Rheims 1899 American Edition (Challoner revision), eBible.org USFM export. Published 1899; marked Public Domain by eBible.org.
Clementine Vulgate (1598) with the Glossa Ordinaria in the Migne edition (1880), eBible.org USFM export. Public domain.
World English Bible, Catholic book order. Dedicated to the public domain; 'World English Bible' is a trademark of eBible.org (do not call a modified text by that name).
OpenBible.info cross references, CC BY 4.0. Uses KJV/English verse numbering; converted to the Vulgate anchor by the pipeline.
Official public podcast RSS feed of The Bible in a Year (with Fr. Mike Schmitz), Ascension. Only metadata (titles, dates, descriptions, enclosure links) is used; audio is never copied.

CrossWire SWORD module 'Catena' (Catena Aurea, Newman translation 1842), DistributionLicense=Public Domain; text source https://github.com/lemtom/catena/ (Tom Lemmens). Covers Matthew, Mark, Luke, John.

Haydock's Catholic Bible Commentary (Geo. L. Haydock, 1811; Douay-Rheims edition 1859), MyBible SQLite module prepared by SermonIndex.net, stated Public Domain. Verse-by-verse, Vulgate/Douay numbering, protocanonical books only.
OpenBible.info Bible Geocoding data: possible modern locations of biblical places with confidence marks. Creative Commons Attribution; credit OpenBible.info (some data from OpenStreetMap, ODbL).
OpenBible.info topical Bible: topics with scored passages (from user votes). Creative Commons Attribution; credit OpenBible.info.
Bishop Barron's Sunday Sermons podcast feed, published for podcast apps. Used only for episode titles, dates, page links and audio addresses; the audio is played from the publisher, never copied.
Ascension's Sunday Homilies with Fr. Mike Schmitz podcast feed, published for podcast apps. Used only for episode titles, dates, page links and audio addresses.

Douay-Rheims Bible, Challoner revision (1749-1752) with its annotations, book introductions and chapter summaries; Project Gutenberg e-text #8300. The underlying text is 18th-century; used for Challoner's notes, book introductions and chapter summaries.
Catholic Public Domain Version (Ronald L. Conte Jr.), JSON export from the scrollmapper/bible_databases project. The translator dedicated the text to the public domain.
Brenton's English Septuagint (1851), eBible.org edition; public domain.
